note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation text, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked on Planet GTA 6. Guides are this atlas's own words. Where the official description is the only confirmed source, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing a location or step.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then side-character finales, collectibles, activities, robberies and money, and save the 100% completion gold for last. It is the final stamp on the whole atlas, not a trophy you chase on its own.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — this is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed as long as you play the story. It pops when the mission's end screen lands, so just follow the mission prompts and do not worry about optional objectives. The official description is the only confirmed source for this one; the mission name itself is the guide.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies are unmissable story progress — finish every mission the chapter offers and this pops at the chapter close. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: guides flag it as the one meditation spot that may not come back, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Outputlag — GTA 6 Trophy List (Lucia balcony meditation, Chapter 1): https://outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable story progress, so keep following the mission markers until the chapter closes. This is also the point where both protagonists are playable and most of the open-world list opens up — a good moment to start the collectible and activity trophies in parallel.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. It is unmissable story progress — finish the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the close. If you have been clearing side-character missions and stranger strands as they appear, Chapter 3 is also a good checkpoint to catch up before the story narrows again.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The last chapter trophy before the finale, and unmissable as long as you finish the story. Before the final mission, make a manual save — guides report there is no mission replay, so a save before the ending is your safety net for anything you still want to mop up afterwards.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Outputlag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay; manual saves): https://outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This gold is unmissable story progress — complete the story and it pops. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission, because guides report no mission replay: that save lets you return to the open world cleanly if you want to finish collectibles and side content after the credits.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, as shown on the game's own stats screen — this gold is the long grind that sits on top of everything else. The visible trophies already sketch the workload: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities, robberies and exploration all feed into it. Treat it as the last trophy: chase the other 53 first, then check the in-game checklist for whatever percentage is still missing. Rockstar has not published the exact 100% checklist, so the in-game stats screen is the source to trust.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (100% workload breakdown): https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total, and the game tracks the running count. This is a background grind: do stunts whenever you are driving between missions instead of saving them all for the end, and the number climbs on its own. A dedicated stunt session in a fast car on open roads finishes the remainder once the story is done.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game once — one go at each, not a win in each. PlayStation tracks the activity types, so work down the list in the pause menu or the activities app: fishing, racing, drone races, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest, one sample of each. The trophy pops the moment the last untried type is sampled, so tick them off early while exploring.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation tracks the count, and every challenge must be gold, not just completed. Work through the ranges weapon by weapon, replaying any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold; the range lets you retry immediately, so a weak run costs nothing but a minute. Save this for a focused session after the story, when you can buy ammo freely and take each challenge calmly.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — PlayStation tracks the locations, and each one needs a win, not just a finish. Learn each course's line on a practice run, then race to win; a lost race can be retried on the spot, so no location is ever locked out. Clear them region by region as you explore, and the last location's win pops the trophy.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses count, repeats of the same race do not. Work through the race list across Leonida, picking courses that suit the car you have, and retry any race you lose until it is won. Pair this with the drone races and stunt driving: every race you win also feeds the stunt and activity totals.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, not just catching a fish on your own. Accept Cal's challenge when it is offered, then out-fish him on the day: steady reeling and keeping the line's tension in the safe zone matters more than speed. If you lose, the challenge can be tried again, so treat the first attempt as a scouting run.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade cabinet, not just start one. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you find and play it through to its end screen. This also counts as one activity type toward Master of None, so do it early while sampling activities.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

The official description is the only confirmed source; the character's name is the guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable: guides report Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 may not return after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — PlayStation tracks the spots, and every one must be visited. This is the one trophy guides flag as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 is reported to disappear after that chapter, and there is no mission replay, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. For the rest, sweep the map region by region after the story and meditate at each marked spot; keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a specific hunt, not any animal. Take Bret's hunting strand when it appears and follow his lead to the unique animal's territory; the hunt itself is the mission. Bring a scoped rifle, approach quietly, and take the shot cleanly — a spooked unique animal may be hard to find again in that attempt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets — three sets finished, not three single cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you explore and check the collection screen to see which sets are close to complete; finish the three easiest sets first. This is a long sweep, so pair it with exploration for The Goodtime State and vehicle discovery.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations — the game's photo-sharing feature, used at 100 distinct spots. Work through Leonida's landmarks and viewpoints, using WAiNK It once at each; repeats at the same spot do not count. Pair it with exploration: every new area you visit for The Goodtime State is a fresh WAiNK It location.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's challenge list, fifty entries ticked off. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, so most of them complete themselves while you chase the other trophies; check the challenge list regularly and mop up the easy ones first. The trophy pops at fifty, so you do not need to finish the whole list.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road away from police spawns, raise the heat with your partner present, then break line of sight and drive until the stars fade — the trophy pops when the wanted level clears with your partner still with you. If your partner leaves or is lost mid-chase, rebuild the heat and try again.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: here you must keep the heat the whole time. Plan a route past three close shops, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next without letting the stars clear or getting caught. If the wanted level drops between shops, the chain breaks and you start over.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one and it is logged. The count climbs fastest by sampling everything you meet: traffic cars, bikes, boats, planes and parked rarities, one of each model. Pair it with exploration and WAiNK It sweeps, and register the best finds to the Scooter Bros app for On the Spot as well.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus — five takedowns before the focus meter runs out. Set it up where enemies group together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns quickly; a powerful automatic weapon helps. If you only manage three or four, reload the attempt and try a denser fight.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a plane without a scheduled flight. The official description is the only confirmed source, so the honest guide is short: get to the airfield, take a plane, and get airborne on your own terms rather than through a mission or a booked flight. Expect police attention, so be ready to fly clear once you are up.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks — and survive the heat, as the description jokes. The official description is the only confirmed source, so no specific step can be cited: in practice this means taking on military hardware at a high wanted level and living to tell about it. Go in with heavy weapons, cover and a fast escape vehicle, and expect a long fight.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, quiet job. Scout the store first, go in when it is quiet, take the goods without tripping alarms or being spotted by staff, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a slower approach.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each — five separate vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Plan each job with an escape vehicle parked nearby, crack the vault, and lose the wanted level before the next one. Vaults can be retried after a failed escape, so a blown getaway costs time, not the trophy.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: https://www.planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — stop a moving truck, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. Ambush the truck on a quiet road, block it, deal with its guards quickly, then drive away and break line of sight until the wanted level clears. The trophy pops when the escape is complete, not when the truck opens.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — PlayStation tracks the areas, and every one must be visited. Drive the whole map methodically, region by region, and check the map's area counter to find the gaps; the last unvisited area pops the trophy. Pair this sweep with vehicle discovery, WAiNK It spots and meditation spots, so one drive feeds four trophies at once.
sources: Official PlayStation trophy description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
